name: apple-container
title_zh: 苹果官方容器 CLI，macOS 上免 Docker
tagline_zh: 在 Apple 芯片 Mac 上，用一条命令把 OCI 容器跑成轻量虚拟机。不用装 Docker 守护进程。
tagline_en: Run OCI containers as lightweight VMs on Apple silicon—no Docker daemon. Pull, build, and manage images with one.
desc_en: Apple's open-source `container` CLI to build, run, and manage OCI/Linux containers as lightweight per-container VMs on Apple-silicon macOS — no Docker daemon required. Use when the user mentions the `container` CLI, "apple container", running or building containers on macOS without Docker/Podman, `container run`, `container build`, `container images`, `container system start`, pushing/pulling imag
why_zh: 每个容器自带独立内核，隔离性比 Docker 强；启动快、资源占用低，且完全开源。
why_en: Each container runs its own kernel for stronger isolation than Docker; fast startup, low overhead, and fully open-source—Apple's.
limit_zh: 仅支持 Apple 芯片 macOS（M 系列），且需 macOS 13+ 和 Xcode 命令行工具。
limit_en: Requires Apple silicon Mac (M-series), macOS 13+, and Xcode CLT; no x86 images, no GPU or custom kernel modules.
title_en: Apple's container CLI: Linux VMs on macOS, no Docker
